Share your logo, photos, draft copy, and any menu or product list. Choose one person to gather feedback and sign off on decisions.

Common questions

How much does a website cost?+

Starter and Business have indicative starting prices. We quote custom work after agreeing the scope.

How long does a website take?+

Starter: about 2–3 weeks. Business: about 4–6 weeks. Custom platforms are scheduled after discovery.

How does payment work?+

A typical project is split into a 50% deposit and 50% before launch. The proposal confirms the payment schedule.

Who owns the website, code, and domain?+

We agree access to the site, source code, and domain before the project starts and document the handover in the proposal.

How many revisions are included?+

Standard packages allow for two rounds of consolidated feedback. Further changes can be scoped separately.

What do hosting and maintenance cost?+

We can quote ongoing updates and maintenance separately. Hosting and domain charges depend on the provider and are listed in the proposal.

Can you add Razorpay or UPI?+

Yes, we can scope a payment gateway or UPI integration separately. The right setup depends on how you confirm payments and fulfil orders.

Can I edit the site myself?+

We can include a content editor for the parts of the site you need to update, such as menus, products, or event details.

Can we work together remotely?+

Yes. We work from India using calls, shared previews, and written feedback. We agree working hours and review times at the start.

Can you work with our existing brand or site?+

Yes. We can use your current identity, redesign a site, or create a visual direction for the web.

What would you like to build?

Tell us what you need and when you’d like it live. We reply within one business day.
